title: Out of Office Beaches | KEY.co
description_expanded: On the main floor, a serene King Master suite awaits, complete with a spa-like ensuite featuring a soaking tub and separate shower. The second floor is a sanctuary of comfort, with another King Master, two Queen rooms with private baths, and a spacious bunk room for the kids. The bonus lounge area provides the perfect spot for movie nights or game days, while the covered lanai transforms into a dreamy outdoor living space. Fire up the grill, sip your favorite cocktail, and bask in the glow of breathtaking sunsets. With all the ingredients for an unforgettable family vacation, this Seacrest Beach gem promises the perfect blend of comfort, style, and coastal charm. This contemporary five-bedroom, five-and-a-half-bathroom retreat in Seacrest Beach is the ultimate haven for multi-generational families seeking the best of Florida’s Emerald Coast. Thoughtfully designed with an open-concept layout, the home boasts a state-of-the-art kitchen and inviting living spaces perfect for gathering and creating cherished memories. Nestled in one of 30A’s most charming coastal communities, it offers effortless access to pristine beaches, vibrant local attractions, and all the beauty the Gulf Coast has to offer. Every detail is curated to ensure a relaxing and luxurious getaway you’ll want to return to year after year.
